# Junk Removal Big Bear

> Junk removal and weed clearing company serving the Big Bear Valley in the San Bernardino Mountains, California: junk removal, weed clearing and fire abatement, cabin, garage, estate and vacation-rental cleanouts, appliance and e-waste removal, hot tub removal, light demolition and minor painting. No moving services. Free on-site quotes.

- Contact: text or WhatsApp (number to be added) — see https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/contact/
- Email: junkremovalbigbear@gmail.com
- Hours: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM, 7 days a week
- Service-area business (no storefront; we come to you)
- Service area: the Big Bear Valley (Big Bear Lake, Big Bear City, Moonridge, Sugarloaf, Fawnskin, Erwin Lake, Baldwin Lake) and nearby mountain communities by arrangement
- Pricing: no published prices; free on-site quotes; price confirmed before work starts.
- Not a licensed contractor: painting, light demolition and similar work limited to minor jobs under California's $1,000 minor-work limit.
- Not accepted: hazardous waste (paint, chemicals, oil, fuels, asbestos, propane tanks).
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=354390746886661546

## Services
- [Weed Clearing & Abatement](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/weed-abatement/): Weeds, pine needles, brush and low limbs cleared to Big Bear Fire standards — and hauled away the same visit.
- [Junk Removal](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/junk-removal/): Single items to full loads — furniture, mattresses, yard debris and everything in between.
- [Cabin, Garage & Home Cleanouts](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/cabin-cleanouts/): Garages, attics, crawl spaces, sheds, storage units and whole-cabin clearances.
- [Estate Cleanouts](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/estate-cleanouts/): Respectful, organized cleanouts of inherited cabins and homes — manageable from off the mountain.
- [Vacation Rental Turnovers](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/vacation-rental-turnovers/): Bulky-item and junk removal for Airbnb and VRBO hosts, scheduled between guest stays.
- [Appliance & E-Waste Removal](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/appliance-e-waste-removal/): Fridges, freezers, washers, dryers, stoves, TVs and computers hauled away.
- [Hot Tub & Spa Removal](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/hot-tub-removal/): Dead spas drained, cut down, carried off the deck and hauled away.
- [Light Demolition](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/light-demolition/): Minor tear-outs: small sheds, deck boards, fencing, cabinets and carpet — hauled off.
- [Painting (Minor Jobs)](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/painting/): Small interior and exterior painting jobs — touch-ups, single rooms, trim, doors, fences.
- [Furniture & mattress removal](https://www.junkremovalbigbear.com/services/furniture-removal/)
